manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Phantom Steed must be exiled by Changeling Titan, and Wormfang Drake must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Wormfang Drake for its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
